owner: Ubilink.AI (Ubitus, Foxlink Group, Shinfox Energy JV)
notes: Foxlink Group (formerly Cheng Uei Precision) inaugurated Ubilink on Nov 14, 2024: Taiwan's largest AI supercomputing center, located in New Taipei City, powered by 1,024 NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs with 45.82 PFLOPS peak, ranked 31st on the Nov 2024 TOP500 and 44th on Green500. Data Center Map lists it under New Taipei City. No MW capacity published.
